row.body: A family photograph is clipped to a key transfer card; the pickup line is marked completed, but the recipient box is blank.
row.title: Names on the family key

sidecar.gloss: A family key is transferred without a named recipient.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field team could have borrowed a household key for a visit; the empty recipient box does not prove anyone was evacuated.

row.body: red and blue cord join the lighter to the bath towel. the red route is cut; the blue route ends in a sealed knot.
row.title: missing count beside the lighter

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
